mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the two routes was most worthwhile: the continuous path made it clear how blood travels through the right heart, lungs, left heart and body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the same two kinds of valve on each side felt repetitive. The intermediate descriptions also made an already-filled chamber gap sound empty.

surprise.text: I had not expected the heart muscle to need its own vessels rather than relying on blood inside the chambers.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained where the parts belonged.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how circulation connects with another body system, though I would hope for fewer repeated fittings.
